Episode 206: The Black Dragon, Murakan, Returns
Black Dragon Murakan.
He had left his colleagues to act as Misha's substitute in April 1800, right after the Sword Emperor War.
At that time, everyone thought Murakan could return quickly. They said he might return to Tikan even before Jin finished his training in Lafrarosa.
However, the seals were the problem.
Elona Zipple and the Eye of Zito.

These two headaches had been binding Talaris and Misha until now. For the past three and a half years, Misha and Talaris had been maintaining the seals while being injured (Talaris was even unconscious until recently, suffering another blow from Rosa even before the wounds from the Sword Emperor War had healed).
"You have worked hard during this period, Misha."
"You've also suffered a lot, Talaris. Being a dragon, the time devoted to the seal didn't feel that long to me... but you still need to keep an eye on the Eye of Zito, which is regrettable."
"Can it compare to the mission you have taken on, Misha? Even if it's impudent, I consider it an honor that the Infinite has received your help."

"Thank you for saying that. My younger brother seems to have done a reasonable job in my stead, but I'm sure there will be many parts that are messed up. Once things are sorted out, I'll come visit once in a while. Let's have a leisurely drink then."

Jin and his colleagues told Misha to rest for a few days before returning, but she said she couldn't because she was anxious. Now that Elona has awakened, in case of a problem, it would be a hundred times better to have Murakan there.
"Don't worry too much about the visit. Including Elona Zipple, we'll take care of everything."
"That's reassuring, Jin. But be careful, avoid a one-on-one showdown with Elona. Always meet with Murakan by your side."
"I understand."
[The Black Dragon, Misha, is from Solderet. It was a brief but pleasant meeting.]

Ameris patted Misha's shoulder and said. Ameris, Misha, Talaris. Even though they didn't know each other for a long time, they felt a deep sense of kinship with each other. All three of them had a mission to maintain the order of the world.
"Ameris, if my younger brother makes a mistake, just hit him. He must be quite close to his prime, so there should be no problem even if you hit him thinking of killing him."
[Ha ha, I won't do that.]
"Misha, it's ready."
Gilly rushed over with two baskets full of pies. The only request Misha made before leaving was to have some strawberry pie made by Gilly.
Wow!
Misha took a big bite of the strawberry pie and seemed to nod in satisfaction.
"That's right, this is the taste... It's refreshing."
Misha quickly finished off one basket and stared at the remaining one.
"Was this made for that guy?"
"Ah, yes, Misha."
"Give it to me, he can eat this every day now. Hmm, good. This one tastes better... no, why does it taste better? Did you discriminate between me and my brother?"
"No way! Definitely not, Misha!"
"Then how do you explain this difference in taste? The strawberries on top of the pie seem to form a heart."
"I definitely made it the same way with the same ingredients. The arrangement is no different from what you just ate, Misha."
"I think it's because love was added, Misha. If everything is truly the same, then there is no other explanation."
Upon hearing Talaris' words, Misha sighed.
"Gilly, I've warned you from the first time we met... Be careful of his preferences. But in the end, it turned out like this. How did a good kid like you end up with a bastard like him."
"I am just a person serving Lord Doran and Murakan."
"Hmm, I'm sure. Since our handsome black dragon brother doesn't have an owner, I'll have to claim him."
As Gilly forced a smile, her colleagues swallowed their laughter, and Misha, thinking it was fun to tease, finished the remaining strawberry pie.
"Thanks to you, I ate very well, Gilly. I really have to go now."
Her colleagues came out to see Misha off. As Misha transformed into her true form and spread her aura, the surroundings turned pitch black.
Huuuung...

Soon, the aura gathered to form a huge dragon mound, and Misha slowly floated into the sky along the flow. The sight was not simply flying, but looked like a sort of ascension, exuding a lofty atmosphere.
[See you all soon.]
The moment Misha turned around and said so, a black dragon appeared through the clouds in the sky.
[Kahaha, kahahahat!]
Murakan's booming laughter echoed throughout the sky.
[Finally! I, have returned!]
[Will you shut up and quietly descend?]
As soon as she got close to Murakan, Misha swung her wing like a fist and slapped his head. Without avoiding it, Murakan snorted and chuckled.
[Kekeke, do you think I'd be hurt by such a blow? Huh?]
[Yes, keep messing around. If you want to be bound to the spirit world again.]
[Tch! Fine, fine. I won't laugh until you leave, okay? That's not a big deal. Hehe, take care, you devil. Well, I tried it too and saw you struggling quite a bit. Serves you right!]
At his words, Misha passed by Murakan, but turned around and dug her sharp claw into his back like a needle.
And then, without any mercy, she beat Murakan's head with her front paw. If it were an ordinary dragon, it would have been dead with a single blow.
[When, will, you, get, your, sanity, back?]
Every syllable was met with a precise hit.
[Ouch, it hurts!]
[Are you kidding me? Do you want to die?]
[Ah! Enough, I have dignity too.]
All that filled the sky, once filled with a sacred atmosphere, was now only full of the brutal beatings and abusive language of the Black Dragon siblings.
In the end, Misha went back to the Spirit Realm after beating up Murakan about fifty times. Murakan, looking rather embarrassed, made a fake cough and looked down at his colleagues.
The first one that caught his eye was not the contractor of a thousand years who had fought through all sorts of challenges without a guardian dragon for the past three years.
It was a woman standing with teary eyes next to him.
It was Gilly.
[Strawberry Pie!]
Murakan, descending swiftly like a hawk. Murakan, who had stylishly transformed into a human, scattering spirit particles, was now holding Gilly in his arms.
"You've had a tough time, Strawberry Pie... But it's okay now. I'm back. I will turn anyone who torments you into dust."
"I, I've been doing very well, Murakan. Of course, none of my colleagues have been tormenting me..."
"But why are you crying?"
"Please put me down first, then talk."
"Strawberry Pie, don't tell me you've come to dislike me? Even if so, I won't let you go now."
"No, it's not that."
"From now on, I, Murakan, will always be by your side."
Thanks to their good looks, the sight was quite beautiful. Even though she had never expressed it, all her colleagues knew how much Gilly had missed him over the years.
However, the colleagues somehow felt a sense of unease.
"Ah, it's cheesy. And kind of uncomfortable. Can't you stop?"
"Kid! Even you can't separate Strawberry Pie and me. You can't stop the joy of reunion."
"Gilly seems uncomfortable too. It's also uncomfortable for us to watch."
In particular, it felt weird for Jin, as Murakan and Gilly were like his parents. It's not often that children can blissfully watch their parents' show of affection.
"....It seems that mother's plan to take over Murakan is totally impossible."
"It was a joke, but even if it were serious, it would have been impossible. Uh, I'm kind of annoyed for some reason, honey. Can you comfort me?"
"Don't cling to me if you don't like it."

Gilly naturally stepped down from Murakan's embrace, adjusting her expression and clothes before coughing awkwardly. Murakan, on the other hand, seemed to have no idea that he should feel embarrassed. All he did was look at his colleagues with a hearty laugh.
"You look much better now. You've been through a lot, Murakan."
"This little guy, you've gotten stronger since the last time I saw you, haven't you? Haha, we've got a lot of catching up to do. There are some faces I've never seen before, too."
[You're even more of a fool than I heard, Murakan. My name is Ameris.]

"When I came over and had a bit of Solderet's insight left, I got a rough idea of what kind of entity you are. You seem like an old existence guarding some boundary of the world. Nice to meet you, I'm Murakan."
[...You're speaking informally?]
"Oh, come on, don't be petty about the way I talk."

Ameris didn't answer, just silently stared at Murakan. While she could easily defeat him in a fight, Murakan turned his head as he felt somewhat guilty. He also had a hunch that Ameris might suddenly attack him, just like Misha.
"Ah, come on, I was on informal terms with Solderet. Okay, okay. I'll speak more politely to you since you seem to be a very difficult demon to deal with. Is that okay?"
[It better be. For your information, the past Solderet always called me with honorifics.]
"I got it. It seems like you're the same type as Tess."
[While you talk as if you despise your sister, you actually deeply respect her. Or is it beyond that, admiration?]
"Can you stop with the disgusting comments?"
Despite having just returned after a long time, Murakan naturally mingled with his colleagues. After just a few words exchanged, everyone already seemed to be in high spirits.

"The situation isn't great, but we should still have a small welcome ceremony since you're back. Let's head to Tikan, everyone is waiting there. Especially Yuria and the kids, they've been dying to see you."
"I heard. Elona Zephyr has awakened, I remember he was quite a tough one. It's strange that I've been forgetting it until now."
"Oh, it sounds like you're not confident. What's the matter? Has the great Murakan already gotten scared?"
"Scared? Kid, I've never felt anything like that in my life."
Jin looked at Murakan for a moment. Indeed, his energy was flowing so grandly that it was difficult for even Jin to gauge.
"That seems likely."
"The situation where I don't have enough power to protect you won't happen anymore, so you can always fight at ease."
"I'm counting on you from now on, Murakan."
"Alright."
Jin and Murakan looked at each other and smiled warmly.
"Meow."
Shortly after, Murakan transformed into a cat and cuddled up in Gilly's arms, but upon experiencing the space leap of the Red Owl, he ended up vomiting.
Jin remembered Murakan vomiting at the transport gate when he first left Storm Castle and laughed at him, while Gilly patted his back, just like she did back then.
